text:
The immediate-after constraints lock Hana–Gus–Dev into three consecutive slots and Finn–Ben into two. Exactly one person between Dev and Elif cannot put Elif on Hana’s slot, so Elif is two after Dev. Exactly one person between Ben and Elif cannot put Ben on Dev’s slot, so the only pattern that fits in slots 1–9 is:

Hana, Gus, Dev, (open), Elif, Finn, Ben

Hana before Ann before Elif puts Ann in that open slot. Exactly one person between Cara and Finn then puts Cara two after Finn, which only works if the block starts at slot 2. Ivo takes the remaining slot.
